page.overview:
What is Camorin?

Camorin is a region in the Dreamlands briefly mentioned in the short story "The White Ship" by H. P. Lovecraft. When Basil Elton spoke of the wonders of the fabled land of Cathuria, he compared its forests of aloe and sandalwood to the "fragrant groves" of Camorin.
